messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] error with skeletor
messages.body_plain:
Hi Ibo,

That’s a pain. The function hasn’t changed recently afaics. Is this definitely the same neuron? There is a poorly handled edge case here in the functionality trying to reroot the neuron on the soma. If you don’t need that then set reroot=F and everything should just work. If you do need to reroot, try reducing the value of

k.soma.search = 10
>From its default value to eg 4. I’ll see with Alex Bates about a patch but he’s away just now. All the best,

Greg.

Sent from my iPhone
